# Denzil Automations

> Done-for-you AI automation agency. We design and build automations that run lead response, follow-ups, bookings, billing and support, wired into the tools you already use.

Denzil Automations builds custom automation systems for growing businesses, so the busywork runs itself and no lead is ever lost. The blog shares practical, deeply researched playbooks on responding to leads faster, following up automatically, capturing leads on WhatsApp, and putting day-to-day operations on autopilot.

## Blog

- [The Best AI Automation Tools, Sorted by the Job](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/ai-automation-tools): A no-hype guide to the best AI automation tools, sorted by the job you want done, with honest costs, the catch on each, and the free options that fit.
- [WhatsApp Lead Generation: Capture More Leads, No Forms](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/whatsapp-lead-generation): Capture far more leads on WhatsApp instead of losing them to forms nobody fills in. Here is how to build a WhatsApp lead engine that qualifies as it goes.
- [From Spreadsheet Chaos to One Live Sales Pipeline](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/spreadsheet-to-pipeline): Stop losing leads across scattered spreadsheets and chats. Here is how to move to one live pipeline that updates itself, without a bloated CRM.
- [How to Stop No-Shows: The Booking and Reminder System](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/stop-no-shows): No-shows waste paid-for time, and most are preventable. Here is the booking and reminder system that reliably brings customers through the door.
- [Done-for-You vs DIY Automation: How to Decide](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/done-for-you-vs-diy-automation): Should you build your automations yourself or hire it out? Here is how to decide, with real numbers on time, cost, and what breaks when it goes wrong.
- [7 Automations Every Growing Business Should Set Up First](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/automations-to-set-up-first): Not sure what to automate first? Here are the seven automations every growing business should set up, in the order that pays back the fastest.
- [AI Agents vs Chatbots: Which One to Use, and When](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/ai-agents-vs-chatbots): Chatbots and AI agents get confused constantly. Here is what really separates them, where each belongs, and which one your customers will thank you for.
- [WhatsApp Automation for Business: What to Automate](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/whatsapp-automation): WhatsApp gets opened 98% of the time. Here is what you can automate, what to keep human, and how to set it up without sounding like a robot.
- [Why Leads Go Cold and the Follow-Up System That Wins](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/why-leads-go-cold): Warm leads rarely say no, they just go quiet. Here is why it happens and the exact follow-up system that brings them back and wins the sale.
- [Speed to Lead: Why the First Five Minutes Decide the Sale](https://automate.workwithdenzil.com/blog/speed-to-lead): A lead you answer within five minutes is up to 21 times likelier to qualify. Here is the research, why almost nobody acts on it, and how to fix it.
